faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about your luxury Egyptian journey
faq.q1: What is the best time to visit Hurghada?
faq.a1: Hurghada is beautiful year-round. For diving, March to November offers the best visibility. For cooler weather, October to April is ideal.
faq.q2: Do I need a visa for Egypt?
faq.a2: Most nationalities can obtain a visa on arrival at Hurghada or Cairo airports. We recommend checking current requirements for your specific country.
faq.q3: Is it safe to travel in Egypt?
faq.a3: Yes, Egypt is very safe for tourists, especially in major areas like Hurghada, Luxor, and Cairo. Our private transfers ensure your comfort and security.
faq.q4: What currency should I bring to Egypt?
faq.a4: While the Egyptian Pound (EGP) is the local currency, USD, EUR, and GBP are widely accepted at tourist sites and hotels. We recommend bringing cash for markets and smaller vendors.
faq.q5: How do I book a trip with VACATION IN EGYPT?
faq.a5: You can book directly through our website, via WhatsApp, or by engaging our elite AI concierge, Tamara. We typically confirm bookings within 2 hours and a dedicated team member will reach out to finalize your bespoke arrangements.
faq.q6: Are meals included in the trips?
faq.a6: Meal inclusions vary by trip and are clearly listed in each trip description. Most day trips include lunch, and our Nile Cruise packages are fully all-inclusive.
